text:
mika: Quick heads-up — planning a minimal base-image rebuild next Tue (prod + staging). Primary asks: 1) RBAC changes for keystore/signer roles, 2) KMS audit-log forwarding (stack/egress), and 3) vuln triage window + rollback plan. Trying to align with oncall schedule.

den a: +1. What opt-in groups are we using for the canary?

mika: Start with 'canary-pool' (low-traffic accounts) -> then 25% app slices -> full. Need signer role change so cosign can sign new layers with ephemeral keys.

owen: For RBAC: prefer to create a new service account 'image-signer-ephemeral' with a very narrow grant. Only allow kms:Encrypt/Decrypt/Sign if you're using envelope keys. Example IAM snippet:```json
{
  "Role": "roles/cloudkms.cryptoSign",
  "Members": ["serviceAccount:image-signer-ephemeral@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
}```
Keep key perms separate from deploy perms.

jules: Who will rotate the cosign key material? Are we doing HSM-backed wrapping or just KMS-enveloped keys?

mika: Plan is KMS-enveloped keys + short-lived signer tokens minted by keystore. We want the signing to happen in a small fleet that has no other privileges.

den a: For audit logs: we need to forward KMS Admin, KMS CryptoOperation, and IAM grant changes to splunk/secure-audit project. Make sure we don't drop stackdriver filters.

sec-oncall: FYI I scheduled a 30m preflight on Mon 09:00 for rollback run-through; keeping pager window clear.

mika: Nice. Two technical Qs: 1) Does cosign support remote signing with KMS envelope only (no private key stored locally)? 2) How do we gate the rollout if the canary shows an increase in 5xxs?

ownen: 1) cosign supports KMS-backed keys with remote signers — use the 'kms://' URI. Example: `cosign sign --key k8s://projects/.../locations/.../keyRings/.../cryptoKeys/...` 2) Gate via metric alerting + feature flag to redirect imagePulls to previous tag. We should also bake an automatic fallback that reverts image references in the deployment if error rate > 2% for 5 minutes.

jules: Add a quick eval: token-level latency for inference containers (we've seen new images shift cold-start ~100ms). Put that in the preflight checklist.

den a: On RBAC change: we need an approval record in the audit ticket (security-approvals) before updating binding. I can create a short PR template for reviewers: list of principals, reason, expiry, and rollback steps.

mika: Perfect. Also want to avoid granting the signer SA access to registries. Keep push/pull separate. Signing should be only signing.

ownen: Agree. Token exchange pattern: signer SA uses KMS to sign and returns the cosign signature object; registry push still requires CI creds.

sec-oncall: Minor nit: ensure the signer nodes have restricted egress — if they can reach arbitrary endpoints we open a risk. Whitelist only KMS, registry, and telemetry endpoints.

mika: Good call. Den a, can you validate the firewall rules? Also can we add a logging sink that tags all KMS CT operations with a label `image-rebuild=<date>`?

den a: Yup. I can add a transient label via the signer wrapper that tags operations. For the sink: create a filter `resource.type="cloud_kms_key" AND protoPayload.methodName="Encrypt" OR protoPayload.methodName="AsymmetricSign" AND labels.image_rebuild="2026-03-31"` and route to secure-audit. Will push infra PR.

jules: For vuln triage: schedule a 2hr window right after canary completion. Security + EngOncall + SRE to monitor CVE spikes and decide whether to pause rollout.

mika: I'll draft the runbook. Items to include: preflight checklist (RBAC PR, logging sink, firewall whitelist, cosign key URI, canary groups), rollback steps (revert deployment tag, revoke signer tokens, and re-sign old tag if needed), and stakeholder notify list.

ownen: Quick command that might help during rollback:```bash
# re-tag previous image and restart deployments
kubectl set image deploy/my-svc my-svc=registry.prod/redwood/my-svc:stable-20260324
kubectl rollout restart deploy/my-svc
```

sec-oncall: +:thumbsup: Add a step to revoke ephemeral signer tokens in the keystore immediately after rollback.

den a: I'll open PRs for: 1) IAM binding (with expiry), 2) logging sink, 3) firewall whitelist. Label them `rebuild-keystore-2026-03-31`.

mika: Thanks all. We'll sync Mon preflight and Tue cutover. If anyone sees blockers post-PR ping me.
sre-bot: deploy-checklist created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deployments/pulls/834 (auto)

jules: small follow-up: can we keep an audit of cosign signature storage in the registry (not just KMS logs)? Some registries strip signatures — ensure our registry preserves OCI signatures or store them in the secure blobstore.

mika: Noted. I'll add registry signature preservation to the checklist.

sec-oncall: One more: oncall will need a quick console command to confirm signer SA last-used time. Suggest `gcloud logging read ...` snippet in the runbook.

den a: I'll paste that in the PR description.

mika: Thanks everyone. Closing thread; see you Mon 09:00 preflight.
